jobs.name: Anya Daily Briefing
jobs.prompt: Generate today's morning micro-lesson following the anya-daily skill. Read the current plan from learner.db, check MEMORY.md for focus and top errors, and personalize from USER.md hobbies. Rotate briefing format (A/B/C/D). Keep it under 200 words. If the learner hasn't practiced in 3+ days, use a gentle re-entry tone.

jobs.name: Anya Light Assessment
jobs.prompt: [SILENT] Run light assessment. Query today's samples from learner.db via tracker_db.py. If no samples today, respond with only [SILENT]. Otherwise calculate: average band per skill, top 3 error recurrence_keys. Update MEMORY.md with EMA-smoothed band averages (alpha=0.3). This is a silent background update — do NOT message the learner.

jobs.name: Anya Weekly Deep Assessment
jobs.prompt: Run deep weekly assessment. Query all samples from the past 7 days, band-history, and error-stats from learner.db via tracker_db.py. Analyze: rolling band scores, new weaknesses, improvements, stagnation. Update MEMORY.md with latest band estimates, current focus, and top errors. Then trigger anya-planner to generate next week's plan. Finally, send the weekly report to the learner using the template in anya-assessment/templates/report.md.
